## concept (5)

- [[copperspice-forum]] - copperspice-forum | id: copperspice-forum - The upstream-community domain: the CopperSpice forum is where questions specific to cs_libguarded - the upstream of this repo's exact guarded-header copies - belong, and a forum answer is community guidance, not specification: it can inform but never settles what the code does.
- [[cpp-community]] - cpp-community | id: cpp-community - The mainstream-practice domain: r/cpp is where an RCU design gets reviewed against mainstream C++ concurrency practice - community review is context that sharpens reasoning, not a build verdict: nothing on the wiki becomes true because a community agrees with it.
- [[cs-libguarded]] - cs-libguarded | id: cs-libguarded - The cs_libguarded domain: CopperSpice's header-only, C++20, BSD 2-clause concurrency-guard library (copyright 2015-2018 Barbara Geller and Ansel Sermersheim) - the upstream both of this repo's guarded-header copies derive from, and the reference point for reasoning about what the code should do versus what this copy does.
- [[libguarded-contract]] - libguarded-contract | id: libguarded-contract - The intended upstream contract domain: the CsLibGuarded documentation (Doxygen, v2.0.1) defines rcu_guarded and the wrapped type's rcu_read_lock / rcu_read_unlock / rcu_write_lock / rcu_write_unlock members - the contract as upstream intends it, which is the yardstick the repo's copies are measured against when they differ.
- [[rcu]] - rcu | id: rcu - The read-copy-update domain: a synchronization scheme whose canonical five-step contract lets many readers traverse a shared structure with no lock on the read side, while an updater makes a new copy, publishes it atomically, waits for pre-existing readers to finish, then retires the old one - and whose defining rule is that updaters cannot block readers or force them to retry.

## gotcha (3)

- [[git]] - git | id: git - git traps in this repo: the log pager never returns inside a tool call, CRLF warnings bury the numbers, and batched git commands race.
- [[powershell]] - powershell | id: powershell - The scan-shaped PowerShell traps in this repo: -Include silently counts 0 on a plain -Path, and every one of them hides behind a count that looks right.
- [[windows]] - windows | id: windows - The windows gotcha file holds no traps itself - it is a pointer; reading it alone undercounts every measured api_layer caveat behind it.

## invariant (4)

- [[build-commands]] - build-commands | id: build-commands - One QOR lib is the unit of verification and only the touched lib rebuilds - stated with build/-j4, run with cmakebuild/--parallel 8; the rule's own text is stale against the tree it governs.
- [[green-is-ok-and-exit-zero]] - green-is-ok-and-exit-zero | id: green-is-ok-and-exit-zero - Green means [OK](n/n) in the output AND shell exit code 0 - the only definition of green in the repo, and no shipped instrument checks the pair; a 0-exit run with no [OK] is not green.
- [[lint]] - lint | id: lint - clang-tidy over the build tree is the lint rule - and as of 18 Nov 2026 it is unjudgeable on this tree: no compilation database exists in either configured directory, so the page carries its red judge openly.
- [[test]] - test | id: test - Tests run as standalone binaries, not ctest - but only 3 QORTest exes are configured, so the green ladder covers three binaries, not the test tree, and the rule's own example is one of the missing ones.

## module (88)

- [[qor_aggregatesource]] - qor_aggregatesource | id: qor_aggregatesource - An Experimental island of a source: an exported class template whose reflection walk extracts every field of a stored struct and drops it - the buffer write is commented out, EOD fires on every pull, and nothing in the tree links or instantiates it.
- [[qor_application]] - qor_application | id: qor_application - Application object built from Roles, Features, Options and Workflows; the widest dependant in the app layer.
- [[qor_arch]] - qor_arch | id: qor_arch - Architecture of built QOR (endianness, word size, arch-dependent facts factored in).
- [[qor_asyncioservice]] - qor_asyncioservice | id: qor_asyncioservice - Async IO service, the portable half of an IOCP/io_uring split; its exported ImplementsAsyncIOService() has no definition, and Service never initialises its context count.
- [[qor_base64decodefilter]] - qor_base64decodefilter | id: qor_base64decodefilter - A Stable-badged Base64 decoder in 4 files and 129 lines that decodes in both flow directions with a home-grown tolerant alphabet; no src/ library consumes it, its only test case is commented out, and the judge's compile printed a standing C4244.
- [[qor_base64encodefilter]] - qor_base64encodefilter | id: qor_base64encodefilter - The encode twin of the decode filter is a different animal: an InlineFilter buffer, not a pipeline Element, with a bit-stuffing encoder that pads per call; it is the only one of the two with a live executable test - the MIME chain case - whose RED phase was a 18-of-24 truncation.
- [[qor_canvas]] - qor_canvas | id: qor_canvas - A thin GL canvas wrapper: hand a renderer canvas some Paint objects, ask it to draw. The window that would show it was commented out, so Show() and Refresh() dereference a null window, the only consumer is commented out of its band and includes a header path that no longer exists, and 48 of the 60 exports of the built dll belong to other libraries.
- [[qor_compiler]] - qor_compiler | id: qor_compiler - Source compiler traits (quirks/specifics per compiler/version; demangling, vtable layout).
- [[qor_console]] - qor_console | id: qor_console - A component console UI that composes per-widget token buffers into WriteLine output; the component Console defaults to the interface no-op unless a platform console is linked, the visible ConsoleUI holder has no usable surface, and TokenBuffer frees its array storage with scalar delete on every reset.
- [[qor_current]] - qor_current | id: qor_current - Current-thread and current-process abstractions; the platform supplies the implementation.
- [[qor_datasink]] - qor_datasink | id: qor_datasink - The pull-mode read end of the pipeline: a 115-line Sink whose Extract pumps a delegate callback, swaps byte order chunk-safely, and is wrapped by a header-only reflection-driven Reader - whose Read helpers throw away the one bool that reports truncation.
- [[qor_datasource]] - qor_datasource | id: qor_datasource - The write end of the datasink pair: a Stable source that inserts structs through a header-only Push-mode Writer whose Write discards Insert's bool - and Insert itself reports success for bytes it never acknowledged when the last write grant comes back null.
- [[qor_deserializersink]] - qor_deserializersink | id: qor_deserializersink - The Experimental sink that feeds pipeline bytes into the qor_serialize Deserializer: a 240-line pre-SPDX folder whose export macro is misspelled, whose link line omits the library its own header names, and whose only consumer is a framework library that closes that edge for it.
- [[qor_desktopui]] - qor_desktopui | id: qor_desktopui - The portable desktop feature: a class whose Run() returns EXIT_FAILURE, an export token shared with three folders that never define it, and one consumer that is commented out of the build and cites a folder that does not exist.
- [[qor_dynamiclibrary]] - qor_dynamiclibrary | id: qor_dynamiclibrary - Dynamic library loading; the gate token is misspelled and every user copies the misspelling.
- [[qor_echo]] - qor_echo | id: qor_echo - The full-model echo protocol: every byte is a valid token and end-of-data is the message boundary, so message splits follow buffer scheduling, not protocol. Both filters discard FinalParse's result (C4189 on both), the 1024-byte advertised cap is never consulted by the library's own 512-byte filters, and all three indexes miss the sixth linked library qor_parser.
- [[qor_egl]] - qor_egl | id: qor_egl - The base component EGL feature and wrapper layer; its display, context, window, session, and surface classes provide inert defaults, while real EGL behavior lives in separate winqor_egl and linqor_egl platform targets, so the qor_egl judge is green mainly because the inert API compiles and links.
- [[qor_error]] - qor_error | id: qor_error - Raise errors of varying severity and handle them; the widest link line of the four flyers.
- [[qor_events]] - qor_events | id: qor_events - Ring-buffer event queue, self-declared prototype; it exports no class, is linked by nothing, and its own index calls three of its four dependencies nothing it includes.
- [[qor_fileconnector]] - qor_fileconnector | id: qor_fileconnector - The most consumed connector and the only configured family member's reference page: a Plug that owns a FileSink and FileSource templated on itself, read by 18 CMake lines including two framework libs that invert the layer naming - with a dead qor_signals edge the graph repeats, a flyer emitted against a library off the link line, and a caller-owned file index stored as a bare pointer that Connect dereferences unchecked.
- [[qor_filesystem]] - qor_filesystem | id: qor_filesystem - std::filesystem facade over an injected platform pimpl; its path properties are process-wide statics that a Windows build fills with POSIX defaults.
- [[qor_generator]] - qor_generator | id: qor_generator - The io-tree serializer engine, a near twin of qor_serialize pointed the other way: a qor_workflow that walks a node queue and writes octets into a caller buffer - the engine behind qor_generatorsource and the JSON generator - carrying qor_parser's compile token, two pump forks, and an index row that drops two of its seven links.
- [[qor_generatorsource]] - qor_generatorsource | id: qor_generatorsource - The pipeline source that drives a qor_generator state machine into the pipeline's write buffer: a header-only template on a three-member cpp base whose Pull truncates byte counts to whole units and reads a zero-byte pull as end-of-data.
- [[qor_gl]] - qor_gl | id: qor_gl - The largest unit in src/framework - 7,867 lines and 29 headers - with a judge that cannot run, because no CMakeLists.txt in the tree descends into the folder.
- [[qor_host]] - qor_host | id: qor_host - Host-process module registry singleton; the widest shared-library dependency in the tree, and its cycle with qor_module is suppressed rather than broken.
- [[qor_http]] - qor_http | id: qor_http - The largest leaf so far and the only one whose judge build is red: HTTPSink's ctor calls new_ref on BufferContext<uint32_t> with no arguments (sink.cpp:11) and BufferContext has only a Buffer*-taking ctor (buffercontext.h:18), so the target does not compile (C2512, exit 1, no dll). 141 files, 6 of 46 TUs compiled, a Hello-World server hard-coded in the filter, and the duplicate http_old declaration resolved by D5 - built once, declared twice.
- [[qor_httpclient]] - qor_httpclient | id: qor_httpclient - The declared-but-never-configured lib: its CMakeLists sits in a folder no add_subdirectory reaches, its own judge command fails with MSB1009, its headers include a src/components/network tree that does not exist, and half its 5,923 lines are compiled by no target in the repo.
- [[qor_image]] - qor_image | id: qor_image - In-memory image object and its pipeline sink; it builds green, sizes nothing, and its one consumer is commented out of the build.
- [[qor_injection]] - qor_injection | id: qor_injection - Dependency injection for the memory subsystem; the shortest dependency line of the core 17.
- [[qor_interception]] - qor_interception | id: qor_interception - Function-level interception framework for AOP; the leaf of the flyer set - three links in, one flyer out.
- [[qor_issue]] - qor_issue | id: qor_issue - Issue base classes and infrastructure; the where/when/what record both other flyers depend on.
- [[qor_jip]] - qor_jip | id: qor_jip - The only target in the group that never enters the configure tree: no add_subdirectory anywhere (judge fails MSB1009), and its add_library names two .cpp files that do not exist on disk. The folder is a half-migrated copy of echo with the entire parser layer deleted mid-move, zero consumers tree-wide, and no FEATURES.md row - a declared target the build has never seen.
- [[qor_jpegdecodefilter]] - qor_jpegdecodefilter | id: qor_jpegdecodefilter - A vendored stb_image JPEG core in a pipeline Filter shell that decodes only the header: Decode parses the header then discards the result, ReadFilter reads nothing and claims one unit, and the single consumer example is commented out of the build with a wrong include path.
- [[qor_jsondata]] - qor_jsondata | id: qor_jsondata - The RFC 8259 grammar in one dll - 17 parser states, 11 generator states and a header-only model; all 29 sources compile, but the index row prints 5 of the 12 link libraries, the umbrella header has zero consumers and a 0-byte object.h sits in the root.
- [[qor_layout]] - qor_layout | id: qor_layout - A terminal-UI layout engine in src/components/ui: a DOM of shared_ptr<Node> built with a | pipeline, laid out by a three-pass protocol (requirement up, box down, visit), with vbox/hbox/dbox/grid/flexbox containers. It replicates the CSS flexbox model per its own header. This is the components sibling of qor_uilayout - different target, and the Focused-focus machinery is live here where it is commented out over there.
- [[qor_linereader]] - qor_linereader | id: qor_linereader - The only pipeline filter in this group with real logic and no consumer: a 43-line CR/LF splitter that treats ReadFilter and WriteFilter as one function, counts bytes not lines, can stall on an empty line, and is registered by a zero-byte bootstrap file.
- [[qor_log]] - qor_log | id: qor_log - Log raising and default handlers; the top of the flyer stack, and it reaches a framework lib.
- [[qor_logaggregator]] - qor_logaggregator | id: qor_logaggregator - The log fan-in service: a ThreadPool-posted listener drains a signal queue into stdout and a rolling .log file. Green judge, 21 consumers, and three real defects in the drain - the pipeline sink is a TODO, the shutdown flag is a plain bool shared across threads, and ReceiveLog writes the log file with no lock while the path FEATURES.md calls Stable.
- [[qor_loghandler]] - qor_loghandler | id: qor_loghandler - An in-thread log handler: filter by level, format one line, emit it as a signal that qor_logaggregator receives. The forward path is real; the fluent WriteToFileSystem() and WriteToPipeline() setters are comment-only no-ops with no backing member, which is what FEATURES.md means by 'Stable, Incomplete'.
- [[qor_module]] - qor_module | id: qor_module - Base static lib linked into every QOR module; carries the module tag and static-library chaining.
- [[qor_netclient]] - qor_netclient | id: qor_netclient - The Stable plug-in-protocol client: a 92-line header wrapping two push-mode pipelines over a SocketConnector, the group's most under-indexed lib (13 libraries linked, 5 in the graph), exercised only by two intermediate examples - and whose protocol member is checked at connect and then used by nothing.
- [[qor_netserver]] - qor_netserver | id: qor_netserver - The group's only configured lib with a green judge: a three-state bind/listen/accept Workflow that posts each accepted client to a ThreadPool running its own three-state session pipeline, matching its unusually long purposes row almost claim for claim - behind a link line of 14 libraries the graph shows as 2, and behind two NDEBUG guards misspelled so they never hold.
- [[qor_opengles]] - qor_opengles | id: qor_opengles - The portable OpenGL ES component: a 5-file shim that pairs an EGL display/context with a single OpenGLESFeature interface and a 622-macro Khronos enum header. The component itself carries no GLES calls - 67 of its 72 virtual entry points are empty inline stubs and the real feature factory is supplied per-OS under src/platform. Its own Setup resolves the EGL feature and then throws the handle away.
- [[qor_optionparser]] - qor_optionparser | id: qor_optionparser - Command-line option parsing; declared but never configured, nothing links it, and no class in the tree implements its interface.
- [[qor_parser]] - qor_parser | id: qor_parser - The grammar framework 18 other CMakeLists link - 9 exported state classes, a template half (combinators plus 15 RFC5234 productions) and 17 tokens; it has no test target of its own, one of its 11 .cpp compiles nothing, and the judge linked nothing new.
- [[qor_parsersink]] - qor_parsersink | id: qor_parsersink - The code-point sink that closes the filter-to-parser chain: its Push parses through a CodePointContext but the line that would report what Parse consumed is commented out - and that discarded count gates the only success signal the pipeline gets.
- [[qor_pipeconnector]] - qor_pipeconnector | id: qor_pipeconnector - The mirror of the clients ghosts: fully configured and judge-green - four TUs compile into a real dll - but functionally a stub: ConnectToName ignores its argument and returns false so the connector can never connect, Configure is declared and never defined, m_pipe is never assigned, and nothing in the repo links the target at all.
- [[qor_pipeline]] - qor_pipeline | id: qor_pipeline - Sink/Source data pipeline whose Pipeline is itself a Filter; widest gate-token surface in the tree and an Element copy path that reads an uninitialised pointer.
- [[qor_platform]] - qor_platform | id: qor_platform - Umbrella of arch+os+compiler; the base the rest of QOR stands on.
- [[qor_property]] - qor_property | id: qor_property - Generic properties and collections, convertible to and from structs by reflection; experimental.
- [[qor_randomsource]] - qor_randomsource | id: qor_randomsource - The pipeline's 'Noise Source' (FEATURES.md calls it Stable): a 33-line header, one override whose ReadBytes re-emits a single random_device sample taken once at construction - a constant byte stream that never ends, whose only in-tree consumer is an unconfigured example with a stale include.
- [[qor_renderer]] - qor_renderer | id: qor_renderer - The densest component in the tree: a vendored fork of the ThorVG vector engine (MIT, 2020-2025) wrapped in a Querysoft module, 101 files / 27,693 lines, with two rasterizers - SwRenderer and GlRenderer - both descending from RenderMethod. Its image-loader factory is compiled almost entirely out: config.h, which defines the THORVG_*_LOADER_SUPPORT macros, is included nowhere (its only reference is a commented line), so the PNG/JPG/SVG/... factories preprocess to nothing and only RawLoader is live.
- [[qor_reporting]] - qor_reporting | id: qor_reporting - Forwarding reporting proxy with a fallback, so low-level libs can report without depending on qor_error.
- [[qor_resources]] - qor_resources | id: qor_resources - Async resource manager behind the ResourceHub Feature; widest link line in the framework, and its Font path parses a font and throws the object away.
- [[qor_role]] - qor_role | id: qor_role - Role and Feature container - the base every application derives from; copyable, and a copy leaves its features pointing at the original.
- [[qor_sercon]] - qor_sercon | id: qor_sercon - A serial-console UI whose portable verbs are stubs - WriteLine and WriteChar have empty bodies - so its 475-line renderer writes into a no-op; nine of its thirteen sources are never compiled, and the class carries another module's export token.
- [[qor_serialize]] - qor_serialize | id: qor_serialize - The io-tree serialization engine (folder io/deserializer, namespace serial): a qor_workflow state machine that parses an octet stream one byte per state-Enter and drives TTF font parsing in qor_resources - with an off-by-one written into both byte-walk paths and two of its six links missing from the index and graph.
- [[qor_signals]] - qor_signals | id: qor_signals - Vendored CsSignal in-process pub/sub; its SignalBase export direction hangs on another target's token and queued connections run inline on the emitting thread.
- [[qor_socketclient]] - qor_socketclient | id: qor_socketclient - The second ghost in the clients folder: the one commented-out line above it hides the socket subdirectory as well as the http one, its judge fails with MSB1009 like its sibling's, and three independent compile blockers - a dead include prefix, an undeclared member, a namespace keyword lost - mean the folder could not compile if it were wired up.
- [[qor_socketconnector]] - qor_socketconnector | id: qor_socketconnector - The one connector with real consumers: judge-green dll, used by netclient, netserver and ten examples; the Connector doubles as Plug and ISocket and can adopt an accepted socket, but the connect path tries only the first resolved address, silently discards nodelay/v6only/timeout, and the deprecated SocketWriter still stubs out byte-order conversion.
- [[qor_sockets]] - qor_sockets | id: qor_sockets - Socket subsystem over registered OS twins; four of ten .cpp built, CreateSocket answers null, and the linker-pull hook it declares is defined only by those twins.
- [[qor_stdfstreamconnector]] - qor_stdfstreamconnector | id: qor_stdfstreamconnector - The smallest configured connector: three std::fstream-owning classes in one dll whose base is a path-holder that never connects, pumping externalized to the sibling source and sink targets; judge-green, index-consistent for once - but FEATURES.md advertises a second target that does not exist and qor_signals is carried unused.
- [[qor_stdifstreamsource]] - qor_stdifstreamsource | id: qor_stdifstreamsource - The ifstream half of the std pipeline pair: a configured, judge-green source plus a self-contained stdifstreamReader facade with the flyer discipline its ofstream sibling dropped - but ReadAll never breaks on a zero-returning process function (permanent spin), and a failed open still stamps the reader ready.
- [[qor_stdinsource]] - qor_stdinsource | id: qor_stdinsource - The stdin half of the console pair: the only std pipeline part whose index matches its link line (qor_error included, and genuinely used) - but LineMode()'s defaulted-true getter silently re-arms line mode every Pull, a normal EOF fires a serious flyer, and the one read test is commented out as a TODO.
- [[qor_stdofstreamsink]] - qor_stdofstreamsink | id: qor_stdofstreamsink - The one target only tests link: a configured, judge-green ofstream sink plus a self-contained stdofstreamWriter facade - but the sink reports write success blind without checking stream state, the writer discards Connect()'s failure and silently writes zero bytes, and the header pulls the ifstream connector it does not use while missing the ofstream one it does.
- [[qor_stdoutsink]] - qor_stdoutsink | id: qor_stdoutsink - The most-consumed pipeline sink in the tree (seven examples, three test rows, a real test file): a configured, judge-green stdout sink whose Push divides fwrite's already-unit count by the unit size a second time, silently under-acknowledging any wide-unit pipeline.
- [[qor_stringsink]] - qor_stringsink | id: qor_stringsink - The simplest of the four sinks: a 26-line append-to-std::string terminal that never refuses a grant, never shrinks, and is copied whole by its only reader - the only sink of the group with a named falsification case, and the terminal of every MIME chain test.
- [[qor_stringsource]] - qor_stringsource | id: qor_stringsource - The pipeline's string-backed source, the only one of the five with a Working status and by far the most exercised - 49 StringSource mentions across the MIME and pipeline suites - yet the only header in the family that marks its members with a foreign module token and one of two targets that hardcode their own name in add_library.
- [[qor_sync]] - qor_sync | id: qor_sync - Curated std sync primitives; its sync_of trait decides the lock behind every shared reference and defaults to a no-op, and its Key class is never constructed.
- [[qor_task]] - qor_task | id: qor_task - Vendored cppcoro coroutines wearing QOR's cancellation coat; its link line names the one library it never includes and omits the one it cannot compile without.
- [[qor_tef]] - qor_tef | id: qor_tef - Type-erased functions ported from magic_func; qor_pp_make_function yields a callable object.
- [[qor_terminal]] - qor_terminal | id: qor_terminal - The framework TUI target: every one of its 11 sources compiles, but Setup, Shutdown, SwapBuffers and Present are empty bodies, the only definition of ImplementsTerminal sits in a Windows sibling, and the FTXUI-derived index row describes qor_tui, not this target.
- [[qor_text]] - qor_text | id: qor_text - String classes for UTF-8, UTF-16 and UCS4 plus code-page encodings; qor::String is UTF8String.
- [[qor_textshaping]] - qor_textshaping | id: qor_textshaping - Text layout and shaping for display; declared but not configured, so its judge cannot go green.
- [[qor_thread]] - qor_thread | id: qor_thread - std::jthread wrapper plus a vendored MIT thread pool; the default constructor starts the thread before the object is a derived object.
- [[qor_threadmemory]] - qor_threadmemory | id: qor_threadmemory - Thread-aware memory subsystem: fastheap, threadheap and smallobjectheap, one heap per thread.
- [[qor_ttf]] - qor_ttf | id: qor_ttf - A TrueType font reader in 16 files - 12 header-only blob, structure and table classes and 3 .cpp, one of which compiles nothing; its own umbrella needs qor_pipeline but the dll never links it, and the only consumer in the tree is one test file.
- [[qor_tui]] - qor_tui | id: qor_tui - The terminal-UI component: 123 files / 23,813 lines under src/components/ui/terminal, built as a dom node tree (42 dom .cpp) over a screen surface and a header-less widgets folder. It is not the framework's qor_terminal (same folder name, FTXUI-derived, different deps); this component is the bare 6-dependency port, links honestly against its index row, and lives in namespace qor::components::tui despite living under a ui/terminal path.
- [[qor_uicommon]] - qor_uicommon | id: qor_uicommon - The qor::ui base classes: twelve header-inline interfaces, one exported class, and two header guards shared with src/components/ui, so each consumer compiles its own copy of the behaviour and can silently drop this folder's twin.
- [[qor_uilayout]] - qor_uilayout | id: qor_uilayout - Three quarters of the folder's .cpp lines reach no target; the half that ships is unmarked, the marked half is a second model, and the flex decorators call a member that does not exist.
- [[qor_uiselector]] - qor_uiselector | id: qor_uiselector - 111 lines, five exported symbols, and no target in the tree links it; the two verbs restate an empty base default and the specification is the desktop feature's comment block copied byte for byte.
- [[qor_uiwidgets]] - qor_uiwidgets | id: qor_uiwidgets - The framework's smallest target - 9 files, 217 lines - and its least-reachable one: one other CMakeLists links it, 21 of the dll's 78 exports are its own, and the desktop Window the Widget base was written for sits in a folder no target compiles.
- [[qor_unicode]] - qor_unicode | id: qor_unicode - Unicode and UTF handling inside the text subsystem; the one text subdirectory that is configured.
- [[qor_unicodetextfilter]] - qor_unicodetextfilter | id: qor_unicodetextfilter - The group's only type-changing filter and the region's only filter with configured consumers: a 636-line BOM-sniffing byte-to-UTF-32 state machine of 27 handlers whose judge prints a C4701 uninitialized-codePoint warning inside the UTF-8 path.
- [[qor_uri]] - qor_uri | id: qor_uri - Configured, linked and green - and empty: the URI class declares five ctors and no members or methods (uri.h:150-159), all five are defined with empty bodies, 73 header lines are a hand-copied System.Uri wish-list that exists nowhere in the tree, and the one construction site tree-wide is an assert-free test. The machine layer still holds the folder up as the template for new modules.
- [[qor_widgets]] - qor_widgets | id: qor_widgets - The widgets component, and the smallest of the 'five densest' group: 7 files / 658 lines in src/components/ui/widgets, offering just an abstract WidgetBase and one concrete Panel over a qor_layout foundation. It links five libraries and its index row is honest, but nothing under src/ links it - its only consumers are an experimental example - and its public header forward-declares Focus and Params that no translation unit in the target defines.
- [[qor_workflow]] - qor_workflow | id: qor_workflow - Two state-machine engines in one target; the widest link line in the app layer, and it trades headers with qor_application over no link edge.
- [[qor_workitem]] - qor_workitem | id: qor_workitem - Lock-free work-contract groups over the untargeted signaltree headers; the normative CONCURRENCY.md is cited twice and exists nowhere, and schedule() is the one verb that trusts its own vtable.
